_note: Offline fixture shaped like a Places API (New) Place Details response. Real listing data for Cafe Azul, Richmond VIC (captured 2026-08-18). Review author names are generalised on purpose - no real personal names in this repo.

editorialSummary.text: Relaxed coffee and brunch destination with large windows, patterned tiles and a leafy courtyard.

text.text: Came here hungry as, lumbered out full. I had the Farmers Breakfast and a flat white. Farmers breakfast is very well done.
Friendly staff, great quality food, pleasant easy going environment. The courtyard out the back is lovely.
Music wasn't too loud, nice decor, good service and the food was nice. For my meal, I ordered scrambled eggs with mushrooms and hash browns.
The service was genuinely warm and thoughtful. We had the beef sausage rolls, a chicken and avocado sandwich, and a couple of muffins.
Great smashed avocado and the acai bowl is generous. The cappuccino was excellent too.
